facts.fact: Executive Decree 95-159 cites Legislative Decree 94-01 of 15 January 1994 on the statistical system as the law under which the ONS is the central statistics institution.
facts.system: Legislative Decree 94-01 of 15 January 1994 on the statistical system

facts.fact: Executive Decree 95-159 of 3 June 1995 restates the statutes of the ONS, made under Articles 11 and 17 of Legislative Decree 94-01.
facts.system: Legislative Decree 94-01 of 15 January 1994 on the statistical system
